Friendly reminder: A bipartisan majority voted to establish these nutrition waivers because no child should go hungry. As supply chain and labor disruptions continue to challenge our food systems, allowing our safety nets to expire will fail our children.

https://t.co/gOWi8E8C1C

In a world full of uncertainties for kids, food security should not be one of them. 

I teamed up with @RepSpanberger to send a letter to House Leadership calling for a path forward to extend @USDA’s school nutrition program flexibilities through the 2022-2023 school year. https://t.co/YiuCVH4ROd

Given the ongoing supply chain disruptions and labor shortages plaguing our school nutrition systems, lifting this lifeline prematurely would be a huge mistake - one that will leave millions of children unsure of where their next meal is coming from.

https://t.co/DZUA8ZNWzj

If the universal school meals put in place during the pandemic expire, schools will see a 40% reduction in funding for food, leaving kids hungry and nutrition departments grappling with high prices. That's why I'm taking the lead on this issue in the House with @RepSpanberger. https://t.co/8hQlLeDQHR

Today, the House passed a bipartisan bill to help federal employees injured on-the-job gain access to healthcare by amending the Federal Workers’ Compensation Act to expand treatment options to allow employees to seek care from Physicians Assistants and Nurse Practitioners.

I’ve been sounding the alarm on the expiring universal school meal issue since March and am relieved by our solution: the Keep Kids Fed Act, which extends flexibilities provided by Families First to ensure schools can continue to provide students with the nutrition they deserve.

Every human deserves to live as their most authentic self, and every American requires equal treatment under the law.

As pride month comes to an end, I will continue the fight to ensure that LGBTQ+ Americans are safe, secure, and free from discrimination.
Sending healing wishes to @POTUS. So thankful you’re only experiencing mild COVID-19 symptoms because of vaccines and boosters. Get well soon, Mr. President!

One year ago today, the House passed @RepDebDingell’s PFAs Action Act to direct the EPA to designate PFAs as a hazardous substance, bar manufacturing of new forever chemicals, and authorize grants for treatment programs. Michiganders can't wait - the Senate must act.

Today, I visited The Great Lakes Water Authority at their Water Works Park Water Treatment Facility to learn how 4 million people in SE Michigan receive safe and clean drinking water and see the incredible infrastructure it takes to make it possible! https://t.co/0sLaGGmhft

House Democrats are fighting for the next generation’s mental and physical wellness. Together, we’ve passed:
 
🧡 The Bipartisan Safer Communities Act
🧡 The Protecting Our Kids Act 
🧡 The Mental Health Matters Act
 
That’s how @HouseDemocrats put #PeopleOverPolitics.

I tested positive for COVID-19 last night. Thankfully I am fully vaccinated, boosted, and only experiencing minor symptoms. I’m taking the next few days to rest so I can return to work as soon as I’m negative.

We have made incredible progress in the fight against cancer, but we still have more work to do. With @POTUS' cancer moonshot initiative, we are working toward reducing the death rate from cancer by at least 50% over the next 25 years.
https://t.co/3KSqoftmM4

Today, the House of Representatives came together to commend the bravery, courage, and resolve of the women and men of Iran who are defending their freedoms in protest in over 133 cities. People all over the world must have the ability to exercise fundamental human rights.

I believe everyone should have access to cancer education, prevention, treatment, and care - no matter where you live, your income, your ethnicity or gender. On this #WorldCancerDay, I’m proud to reaffirm my support for @POTUS’ Cancer Moonshot–it's time to #CloseTheCareGap.

Agriculture and nutrition policy goes hand-in-hand. We can't discuss fighting hunger in America without supporting our farmers and ranchers. 

That's why I'll vote for a farm bill that supports everyone: farm families and the families they feed. #NationalAgDay

Paris Hilton was back in the People’s House! Thank you @ParisHilton, for traveling to D.C. yesterday to introduce the #StopInstitutionalChildAbuse Act and advocate for children nationwide. No child deserves to be abused in the name of treatment - I am with you in this fight. https://t.co/IapvJwoRip

This #TreatmentCourtMonth, we honor the 4,000 treatment court programs nationwide, including those in Michigan, that save lives, reunite families, and strengthen communities. When we address addiction with evidence-based treatment and recovery support, we #AllRise.

This National Women’s Health Week, be sure to check in on your physical, mental, social, and emotional health:

🩺 Schedule your checkups
🍎 Enjoy a healthy & balanced diet
🏃‍♀️ Get active
🧠 Prioritize your mental health

IQAir recommends Detroiters to take the following steps in response to poor air quality in the area:

✅ Wear a mask if you need to be outdoors
✅ Run an air purifier if you have one
✅ Close your windows
✅ Avoid outdoor exercise

Stay safe, Michigan! 

https://t.co/qtPkn1Fgvs

Narcan saves lives. I’m glad to see that it will be available over the counter and more easily accessible.

But, we must do more to ensure access to effective treatment for those with opioid-use disorders.

https://t.co/iwcFqk0xxQ

I'm encouraged to see the @DeptofDefense is taking steps to remedy some of the unfair treatment of LGBTQI+ service members who received less than honorable treatment for being themselves. Such treatment should have never happened in the first place.

This decision puts doctors and patients at risk.
 
Doctors need the freedom to work with their patients to make necessary medical decisions without the interference of the state.
 
Abortion is healthcare. https://t.co/OdfLoi5GQ8

Colorectal cancer is the leading cancer death in men under 50.
 
I’m joining @RepDebDingell in petitioning @HHSGov to treat a follow-up colonoscopy as a preventative service, which will lower costs for patients and increase access.
